indirect_and_animation_inventory.result: zero entries between first ExecStart and PlayingSound in all four R1 traces; no direct reachable caller in covered startup graph

startup_timeline: BGM LoadMusic(0) creates PlayBGM at zero volume and immediately Pause(true)
playGayaSound runs in all modes; Standard background plus not-Practice starts Gaya only in Live
Gaya starts as an owned loop at caller volume 1.0 with 0.5-second fade-in
Live requests and waits for optional live-start voice; Practice bypasses it
Standard OnStartMusic/Stage StartAnimation is followed by the evidenced one-second wait
fadeOutGayaSound fades from current effective resource volume to zero over 1.5 seconds and stops at zero
PlayingNone(4) is published before MusicManager.PlayMusic unpauses prepared BGM; updatePlayingSound publishes PlayingSound(5)

loop_mapping.basis: PlayLoop sets CriAtomSourceBase._loop=true without cue-specific loop-point arguments; portable MP3 and current CRI both decode to 310191 frames and neither profile exposes distinct loop points.

lifecycle.initial: Live owns one Gaya resource from PlaySELoop return until FadeVolume stop-at-zero; Practice keeps the field null.
lifecycle.retry: Manual and Auto Rehearsal traces enter a fresh Practice ExecStart and never create Gaya.
lifecycle.move_time: Both directions and both input modes call StopAll, load target BGM paused, traverse 15/16/4 and unpause; no Gaya or voice startup owner is created.
lifecycle.pause_resume: Pause is unavailable before PlayingSound. SoundManager.Pause applies Pause/Resume to BGM, SE and voice resources, including a still-fading Gaya owner; the fade coroutine is Time.deltaTime-driven.
lifecycle.abort_gameover_natural_dispose: Publicly reachable abort/game-over/natural paths begin after PlayingSound, when the initial Gaya stop-at-zero fade has already been scheduled. Exit removes BGM/chorus/tap/directional bundles and restores system volume. Portable rollback/fault/dispose must still synchronously stop any partially created owner because no original user input is accepted before the gameplay gate.
